query:
UPDATE remote_file_versions rfv
            SET status = $1,
                status_history = rfv.status_history || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_array(to_jsonb(now()), $1::jsonb))
            FROM backup_config bc
            WHERE rfv.user_id = $2
              AND rfv.name_blind_index = $3
              AND bc.id = $4
              AND bc.user_id = rfv.user_id
              AND bc.local_device_id = rfv.device_id
              AND bc.storage_id = rfv.storage_id
              AND (rfv.status = '"VerifiedOnRemoteStorage"' OR rfv.status = '"Restored"')
